falsifier: Any retained sample has the wrong C_z rank; C_z z is nonzero; ker A differs from the Hermitian complement of z in ker C_z; ker C_z differs from C z plus ker A; the Gaussian-rational and FLINT realification ranks disagree; or replacing z by an independent vector of ker C_z leaves the complement equal to ker A.

mutation.input_change: At each sample, replace z in the Hermitian pairing by the first recorded vector of ker C_z that is linearly independent of z before recomputing the complement.

scope.sample_boundary: The record covers all nine path-supported nullity-twelve basepoints, parameters 1, 2, and 3 on all 33 retained nullity-eight arcs, and the coordinate-isotropic-plane representative of each nullity-sixteen orbit. It verifies the lemma on those exact samples rather than proving it on every point of the strata.
scope.statement: For every retained sample, ker C_z is the orthogonal direct sum of C z and the bordered kernel, where orthogonality uses the positive Hermitian pairing.
